title: Receiving at the workshop
intro: Garments in transit are listed on the workshop Receiving page. Recording receipt transfers responsibility for the garment to the workshop.

steps.title: Record receipt of the garment
steps.body: Open Receiving. Select Receive against the incoming garment (1). Receive holds the garment in Parking for later scheduling. Receive and Start passes it directly to the scheduler.

steps.title: Release the garment from Parking
steps.body: A received garment is held in Parking until its work is planned. Select Schedule (1) to pass it to the scheduler.
